name: Moldovan Citizenship by Naturalisation (Law No. 253/2025, Art. 14)

requirements.blocker_text: 10 years of continuous legal residence in Moldova.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Romanian language proficiency and basic knowledge of the Constitution, tested under Art. 15 (exemptions: severe disability, 'state interest' grants, children under 14).
requirements.fix_path: Pass the required language and civics examination.

requirement_groups.name: Reduced period -- stateless persons, refugees, protection beneficiaries

requirements.blocker_text: 8 years of continuous legal residence for stateless persons, recognized refugees, or beneficiaries of humanitarian/subsidiary protection -- this reduced figure carries over from the repealed Law No. 1024/2000 and has not been independently re-confirmed against the new Law No. 253/2025's exact article.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of continuous legal residence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 10 (or 8) years' continuous legal residence
Romanian language and civics test certificate

sources.title: Unofficial WordPress mirror hosting -- Law No. 253/2025 on Citizenship of the Republic of Moldova, full text: Art. 14 (10yr standard residence, unchanged in substance from the repealed 1024/2000), Art. 15 (Romanian language + civics test, a NEW tightened requirement vs. the old law), Art. 23 (dual citizenship permitted)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Moldova). STATUS: DRAFT -- MARQUEE FINDING FOR THIS FILE: Moldova's ENTIRE citizenship law was replaced in 2025. Law No. 1024/2000 (in force for a quarter-century) was repealed and superseded by Law No. 253/2025, which entered into force around 24 September 2025 -- roughly a year before this build. This is a live legal transition on the same scale as Slovakia's 2026 Czechoslovak-descent amendment found elsewhere in this dataset. The primary text of the NEW law could not be reached on any official channel in this build -- legis.md (Moldova's own legislation portal) returned only a JS loading placeholder on direct fetch, and monitorul.gov.md (the Official Gazette) was not successfully reached either. The ONLY full-text source located is an unofficial WordPress mirror (tier 4). The 10-year standard residence figure appears unchanged from the old law per cross-checked secondary reporting, but the Romanian-language/civics test under Art. 15 is confirmed as a NEWLY TIGHTENED requirement not present in the same form under the old law. The 8-year reduced period for stateless/refugee applicants is carried forward from 1024/2000-era sourcing and has NOT been independently re-confirmed against the new law's exact article -- flagged explicitly as inherited, not verified. Re-fetching legis.md or monitorul.gov.md directly is the single highest-priority follow-up for this entire Moldova build, since it affects every citizenship file below.
